newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa falls 5 pct, coffee weak, sugar firms.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa falls 5 pct, coffee weak, sugar firms.

text.p: COCOA - Slumps five percent on heavy trade, spec long liquidation. May ends down 45 at 879 stg, all weaker.
SUGAR - Trade buying stokes nearbys after NY rally. AA-boosted volume extremely high. March up $3.70 at $303.30 at 1705 GMT.
COFFEE - Extends losses after weaker NY, March/May spread active. March closes $18 lower at $1,540, off lows.
